Axiom:
Project-local ESLint plugins (custom rules) follow the same meta-policy: - Default: ship a working `fix` for every reported finding. - Allowed alternative: ship without `fix` ONLY if the rule is enabled with an explanatory comment, the same way a third-party non-autofix rule would be. - Severity always `'error'`.
A custom rule shipping only `suggest` is rejected at code review.
